Messages.Author: Patrick van der Reest
Messages.Body:
Can (the effect of) superior Tier of Souls be moved to the vampire
playing
Shepherd's Innocence? I searched the online rulings, but could not
find anything relating to this...

Relevant card texts:

Shepherd's Innocence [DS:C2]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Animalism
+1 stealth action.
[ani] <(D)> Take control of a card in play that requires Animalism. If
it is an equipment or retainer card, place it on any vampire you
control.
[ANI] Take control of all cards in play that require Animalism. You
may put the equipment and retainer cards on any vampires you control.

Tier of Souls [Sabbat:R, SW:R, Anarchs:PG]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Animalism
[ani] (D) Move 1 blood from a minion controlled by your prey to this
vampire.
[ANI] As above, and put this card on the acting vampire. This vampire
gets +1 bleed when bleeding your prey. A vampire may have only 1 Tier
of Souls. Any minion may burn this card as a (D) action.

Thanks and regards.

Patrick
Columbus, OH

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On 2 Mar 2004 11:11:29 -0800, sam...@hotmail.com (Patrick van der
Reest) scrawled:

>Can (the effect of) superior Tier of Souls be moved to the vampire
>playing
>Shepherd's Innocence? I searched the online rulings, but could not
>find anything relating to this...

you take control of it. however, because shepherd's only says stuff
about moving retainers/equipment, you leave the tier of souls on the
vampire it is on.

HOWEVER, because YOU now control it, wherever tier of souls mentions
'you' it's talking about YOU, the new controller. so the vamp with the
tier gets +1 bleed against YOUR prey (handy for deflections), and also
YOU are the one who is the target of the D action to burn the tier (so
only you can block, barring eagle's sight etc).
